S046-01.notes: Confession comes only after others have pieced things together and changes nothing -> 'belated'. Inserted all four: courageous (no support), fabricated (contradicts 'admits'), ambiguous (no support).

S046-02.notes: Within-individual pitch rising with daily noise links pitch directly to noise and rules out body-size confound. A supports the rival explanation; C and D irrelevant. Factually consistent with great tit urban-song research (Slabbekoorn & Peet).

flags: minor: B (total rose by 700) is a plausible lure since a net rise is weakly consistent with new visits, but it does not address shifting; C is clearly the most direct support
S046-03.notes: Before: 3,600 daytime/600 evening; after: 3,500 daytime/1,400 evening. Evening +800, daytime -100 -> C accurate and directly addresses shifting. A shows growth but could be shifting; D irrelevant. All figures in C verified.

flags: minor: 'grant that records are precise' is an inference (Moss 'does not dismiss written sources'), not stated outright, but no other choice is defensible
S046-04.notes: Moss says records reflect official concerns and omit diet, building, trade revealed by excavation; neither evidence complete alone. B too extreme, C contradicts, D unsupported.

S046-05.notes: Describes sponge skeleton, reports finding about diagonal struts resisting bending, notes possible use in towers/bridges. Factually accurate (Euplectella aspergillum lattice studies).

S046-06.notes: Plural, non-possessive 'dozens of'. Apostrophe forms wrong; 'discovered dozen of entries' ungrammatical.

S046-07.notes: Two independent clauses: 'width. A year later, they surveyed...'. B comma splice, C run-on, D misplaced comma after 'and'.

S046-08.notes: Subject is singular 'The number'; interrupting phrase about counts is a distractor. A, B, D are plural verbs. 'rose' is singular-compatible and fits past three-month period.

S046-10.notes: Only B gives both before and after costs ($100 -> ~$10), showing the size of the reduction. D gives only the before cost. Facts (1825, Albany-Buffalo, ~$100 to ~$10/ton) match standard accounts.
